actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 is exact rejected fullsize PNG editing target. Image2 unchanged original small card alone governs source-visible decoration, pose, clothes, hair, crop and light. Image3 supplies mascot identity/anatomy only.
Correct ONLY the clearly visible central chest medal omitted from Image1. On Image2 a small PALE/WHITE CROSS-SHAPED medal with a modest dark/gold central fitting is exposed immediately BELOW the gold-leaf closed collar, just image-left of the overlapping note. Restore this actual pale cross silhouette at the original note-limited position and scale, with believable material and attachment shadow. It is a separate pendant/chest decoration, not a plain round collar button and not a new row of ribbons. Keep any original collar fastening separate. Do not invent fine engraving, readable symbols, extra hidden medal arms/rows or decorations behind paper; preserve source-limited visible shape only.
Keep already correct bare short dark slick-parted hair and real brow hair, green-ringed black eyes, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth. Preserve compact rounded short yellow head against broad raised CLOSED dark green gold-leaf collar, red/gold shoulder edges, source garment opening/fastening and only other truly visible ribbon areas. No new shirt, tie, hat, spectacles, moustache/beard, long yellow jaw or neck shaft, pinched/floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Keep primary angle/head roll, original grey light/crop, complete tilted dark frame, OPAQUE photographic backing and lower-right cream paper note with faint indistinct marks and actual overlap. All skin/hair/dark cloth/collar/medal/frame/backing/note stay opaque; genuine alpha only outside entire original card. No additional figures, labels, watermark, readable text or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
